english.title: Population Yields
english.description: Requires either the Rise and Fall or the Gathering Storm ruleset. Each city of a human major player gains +2 Gold, +0.5 Production, +1 Faith, +0.5 Science, and +0.5 Culture per population.

schinese.title: 人口产出
schinese.description: 适用于迭起兴衰或风云变幻规则集。人类主要玩家的每座城市每人口额外提供+2金币、+0.5生产力、+1信仰、+0.5科技和+0.5文化。
